extName.description: The extension name, as shown in the Chrome toolbar tooltip, chrome://extensions and the Web Store listing. Referenced from manifest.config.ts as __MSG_extName__.

extDescription.message: Chat in a side panel with a local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model, and let it act on the page through WebMCP tools.
extDescription.description: The extension description, as shown in chrome://extensions and the Web Store listing. Referenced from manifest.config.ts as __MSG_extDescription__. Kept in step with package.json's "description", which is what it was hardcoded from before card 100.

extActionTitle.description: The toolbar button's tooltip. Referenced from manifest.config.ts as __MSG_extActionTitle__. Chrome's fallback is the extension name, which is a proper noun in every locale and says nothing about what the button does.
